## Load packages

```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(here, limpa, limma, dplyr, tidyr, tibble, purrr, readr, readxl, ggplot2,
  patchwork, ggrepel, writexl)
here::i_am("08_Plasticity/01_plasticity/a_script/01_plasticity.qmd")
set.seed(2026)
```

## Read inputs

Earlier stages test BFR against HLRT one protein, set or module at a time and find no between-arm
hit, so this step compares the two training responses as wholes.

```{r read}
stage <- here("08_Plasticity", "01_plasticity")
proteins <- readRDS(here("01_Preprocess", "02_Quantification", "c_data", "proteins.rds"))
adjusted <- readRDS(here("01_Preprocess", "02_Quantification", "c_data", "proteins_adjusted.rds"))
d <- readRDS(here("02_Differential_Expression", "01_Design", "c_data", "design.rds"))
fit <- readRDS(here("02_Differential_Expression", "02_Differential", "c_data", "fit.rds"))
dep <- read_excel(
  here("02_Differential_Expression", "02_Differential", "c_data", "02_differential.xlsx"),
  "protein_results"
)
gene_sets <- readRDS(here("03_Pathway_Enrichment", "00_build_gene_sets", "c_data",
  "gene_sets.rds"))
set_tests <- read_excel(
  here("03_Pathway_Enrichment", "01_run_fgsea_and_fry", "c_data", "01_run_fgsea_and_fry.xlsx"),
  "set_tests"
)
module_file <- here("04_Network", "01_modules", "c_data", "01_modules.xlsx")
splsda_file <- here("07_Multivariate", "02_splsda", "c_data", "02_splsda.xlsx")
phenotype <- read_csv(here("00_Input", "phenotype.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(identical(dep$protein, rownames(proteins)), identical(dep$protein, rownames(adjusted)),
  identical(dep$protein, rownames(fit$t)))

ct_bfr <- "BFR_Post-Pre"
ct_hlrt <- "HLRT_Post-Pre"
ct_inter <- "Modality_x_Time_Interaction"
dep_stat <- function(contrast, stat) dep[[paste0(contrast, "_", stat)]]
arm_colours <- c(BFR = "#D55E00", HLRT = "#0072B2", Both = "grey30")
set_databases <- c("Hallmark", "GO_Slim", "Reactome")
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 8) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")))
origin_lines <- list(
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey80"), geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey80"),
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60")
)
```

## Magnitude

### Training hits

A difference in hit counts is not a test of a difference between arms; the cross-fit and the
directional change below are.

```{r counts}
counts <- expand_grid(arm = c("BFR", "HLRT"), level = c("FDR < 0.05", "p < 0.05")) |>
  mutate(
    contrast = if_else(arm == "BFR", ct_bfr, ct_hlrt),
    stat = if_else(level == "FDR < 0.05", "adj.P.Val", "P.Value"),
    passing = map2(contrast, stat, function(ct, stat) dep_stat(ct, stat) < 0.05),
    up = map2_int(passing, contrast, function(k, ct) sum(k & dep_stat(ct, "logFC") > 0)),
    down = map2_int(passing, contrast, function(k, ct) sum(k & dep_stat(ct, "logFC") < 0))
  ) |>
  select(arm, level, up, down)
counts
```

### Leg changes

The cross-fit and the directional test use the participants with all four biopsies, so every
comparison is within person.

```{r changes}
leg_samples <- adjusted$targets |>
  select(participant, leg, treatment, timepoint, sample_id) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = sample_id) |>
  drop_na(T1, T2)
leg_change <- adjusted$E[, leg_samples$T2] - adjusted$E[, leg_samples$T1]
complete_legs <- leg_samples |>
  select(participant, treatment, T1, T2) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = c(T1, T2)) |>
  drop_na()
change_bfr <- adjusted$E[, complete_legs$T2_BFR] - adjusted$E[, complete_legs$T1_BFR]
change_hlrt <- adjusted$E[, complete_legs$T2_HLRT] - adjusted$E[, complete_legs$T1_HLRT]
n_complete <- nrow(complete_legs)
bh_size <- c(BFR = sum(dep_stat(ct_bfr, "adj.P.Val") < 0.05),
  HLRT = sum(dep_stat(ct_hlrt, "adj.P.Val") < 0.05))
c(legs = nrow(leg_samples), complete_participants = n_complete, bh_size)
```

### Cross-fitted magnitude

Choosing proteins by one arm and measuring that arm on the same people inflates it, so half the
participants choose and the other half measure, over 200 splits (as in the YvO Figure 4C). The swap
p compares the ratio with 200 data sets in which each participant's arm labels are swapped.

```{r crossfit}
# split_low and split_high are the middle 95% of splits, not a confidence interval
crossfit <- function(x_bfr, x_hlrt, splits) {
  map(seq_len(splits), function(split) {
    half <- sample(n_complete, n_complete %/% 2)
    measured <- list(BFR = abs(rowMeans(x_bfr[, -half])), HLRT = abs(rowMeans(x_hlrt[, -half])))
    chooser <- list(BFR = abs(rowMeans(x_bfr[, half])), HLRT = abs(rowMeans(x_hlrt[, half])))
    expand_grid(selected_on = c("HLRT", "BFR"), set = c("All", "Top 500", "Top 250", "BH")) |>
      mutate(
        size = case_when(
          set == "All" ~ nrow(x_bfr), set == "Top 500" ~ 500, set == "Top 250" ~ 250,
          .default = bh_size[selected_on]
        ),
        chosen = map2(selected_on, size, function(arm, k) {
          rank(-chooser[[arm]], ties.method = "first") <= k
        }),
        bfr = map_dbl(chosen, function(k) median(measured$BFR[k])),
        hlrt = map_dbl(chosen, function(k) median(measured$HLRT[k]))
      ) |>
      select(-chosen)
  }) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    mutate(ratio = bfr / hlrt)
}
split_results <- crossfit(change_bfr, change_hlrt, 200)
swapped <- map(seq_len(200), function(i) {
  flip <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), n_complete, replace = TRUE)
  swap_bfr <- change_bfr
  swap_hlrt <- change_hlrt
  swap_bfr[, flip] <- change_hlrt[, flip]
  swap_hlrt[, flip] <- change_bfr[, flip]
  summarise(crossfit(swap_bfr, swap_hlrt, 200), null_ratio = median(ratio),
    .by = c(selected_on, set))
}) |>
  list_rbind()
magnitude <- split_results |>
  summarise(
    split_low = quantile(ratio, 0.025), split_high = quantile(ratio, 0.975),
    size = first(size), bfr = median(bfr), hlrt = median(hlrt), ratio = median(ratio),
    .by = c(selected_on, set)
  ) |>
  left_join(summarise(swapped, nulls = list(null_ratio), .by = c(selected_on, set)),
    by = c("selected_on", "set")) |>
  mutate(swap_p = map2_dbl(nulls, ratio, function(null, r) {
    (1 + sum(abs(log(null)) >= abs(log(r)))) / (1 + length(null))
  })) |>
  select(selected_on, set, size, bfr, hlrt, ratio, split_low, split_high, swap_p)
mutate(magnitude, across(where(is.double), function(x) signif(x, 3)))
```

### Directional change

Proteins are chosen by a time-only model that pools the arms, which cannot bias the between-arm
difference because swapping a participant's legs leaves the pooled effect unchanged. Each leg's
change on them, signed by the training direction, says how far that leg moved the way training
moves the proteome.

```{r time-only}
time_design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + participant + timepoint + blood, proteins$targets)
time_fit <- topTable(eBayes(dpcDE(proteins, time_design, plot = FALSE), robust = TRUE),
  coef = "timepointT2", number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
time_rows <- time_fit$adj.P.Val < 0.05
time_sign <- sign(time_fit$logFC[time_rows])
training_set <- list(
  up = rownames(time_fit)[time_rows & time_fit$logFC > 0],
  down = rownames(time_fit)[time_rows & time_fit$logFC < 0]
)
lengths(training_set)
```

```{r directional}
directional <- function(x) colMeans(x[time_rows, , drop = FALSE] * time_sign)
directional_pairs <- tibble(
  participant = complete_legs$participant,
  BFR = directional(change_bfr), HLRT = directional(change_hlrt)
)
directional_test <- tibble(
  test = "directional change", proteins = sum(time_rows),
  bfr = mean(directional_pairs$BFR), hlrt = mean(directional_pairs$HLRT),
  ratio = bfr / hlrt,
  p = t.test(directional_pairs$BFR, directional_pairs$HLRT, paired = TRUE)$p.value
)
directional_test
```

### fry on the interaction

If BFR responds less, the interaction of the rising training proteins leans negative and that of
the falling ones positive. fry tests both sets in the stage 02 model.

```{r fry-interaction}
proteins$weights <- fit$EList$weights
interaction_contrast <- d$contrasts[, ct_inter]
interaction_change <- set_names(dep_stat(ct_inter, "logFC"), dep$protein)
fry_interaction <- fry(proteins, training_set, d$design, interaction_contrast, robust = TRUE,
  sort = "none") |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "set") |>
  mutate(
    median_training = map_dbl(training_set, function(rows) median(time_fit[rows, "logFC"])),
    median_interaction = map_dbl(training_set, function(rows) median(interaction_change[rows]))
  )
fry_interaction
```

### Magnitude page

```{r page-magnitude}
count_plot <- counts |>
  pivot_longer(c(up, down), names_to = "direction", values_to = "proteins") |>
  mutate(proteins = if_else(direction == "down", -proteins, proteins)) |>
  ggplot(aes(arm, proteins, fill = arm)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(label = abs(proteins), vjust = if_else(proteins > 0, -0.3, 1.2)), size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~level, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(0.15)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colours) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proteins (up above zero, down below)", title = "a  Training hits")
bars <- magnitude |>
  mutate(
    set = factor(set, c("All", "Top 500", "Top 250", "BH")),
    selected_on = factor(paste("Chosen by", selected_on), c("Chosen by HLRT", "Chosen by BFR")),
    label = sprintf("%.2f\n(%.2f-%.2f)\np %.2f", ratio, split_low, split_high, swap_p)
  )
magnitude_plot <- bars |>
  pivot_longer(c(bfr, hlrt), names_to = "arm", values_to = "median_change") |>
  mutate(arm = toupper(arm)) |>
  ggplot(aes(set, median_change, fill = arm)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = bars, aes(set, pmax(bfr, hlrt), label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.15, size = 2.3, lineheight = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~selected_on) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colours) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.45))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Median |log2 change|, held-out half", fill = NULL,
    title = "c  Cross-fitted magnitude",
    subtitle = "Labels: BFR/HLRT ratio, middle 95% of 200 splits, swap p") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
score_plot <- directional_pairs |>
  pivot_longer(c(BFR, HLRT), names_to = "arm", values_to = "score") |>
  ggplot(aes(arm, score, group = participant)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey80") +
  geom_line(colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = arm), size = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = arm_colours) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Directional mean change (log2)", title = "b  Directional change",
    subtitle = sprintf("%d training-responsive proteins\nBFR/HLRT %.2f, paired p %.2f",
      directional_test$proteins, directional_test$ratio, directional_test$p))
page_magnitude <- (count_plot | score_plot) / magnitude_plot / plot_spacer() +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.1, 0.5)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Magnitude: how far each leg moved")
page_magnitude
```

## Direction

Whether the legs moved the same proteins the same way, and what each quadrant holds. The Deming
slope is descriptive: most points are HLRT hits chosen for a large HLRT change, so it is biased low.

```{r direction}
bh_in <- function(bfr_fdr, hlrt_fdr) {
  case_when(bfr_fdr < 0.05 & hlrt_fdr < 0.05 ~ "Both", bfr_fdr < 0.05 ~ "BFR",
    hlrt_fdr < 0.05 ~ "HLRT", .default = "neither")
}
direction_hits <- tibble(
  protein = dep$protein, gene = dep$Genes,
  bfr_logfc = dep_stat(ct_bfr, "logFC"), bfr_fdr = dep_stat(ct_bfr, "adj.P.Val"),
  hlrt_logfc = dep_stat(ct_hlrt, "logFC"), hlrt_fdr = dep_stat(ct_hlrt, "adj.P.Val")
) |>
  filter(bfr_fdr < 0.05 | hlrt_fdr < 0.05) |>
  mutate(
    hit = bh_in(bfr_fdr, hlrt_fdr),
    quadrant = paste0(if_else(hlrt_logfc > 0, "HLRT up", "HLRT down"), ", ",
      if_else(bfr_logfc > 0, "BFR up", "BFR down"))
  )
concordance <- mean(sign(direction_hits$bfr_logfc) == sign(direction_hits$hlrt_logfc))
deming_slope <- with(direction_hits, {
  s <- cov(cbind(hlrt_logfc, bfr_logfc))
  (s[2, 2] - s[1, 1] + sqrt((s[2, 2] - s[1, 1])^2 + 4 * s[1, 2]^2)) / (2 * s[1, 2])
})
count(direction_hits, hit)
count(direction_hits, quadrant)
c(concordance = concordance, deming_slope = deming_slope)
```

```{r quadrant-sets}
universe <- unique(dep$Genes)
ora_sets <- gene_sets[sub("\\|.*", "", names(gene_sets)) %in% set_databases]
quadrant_sets <- direction_hits |>
  summarise(members = list(unique(gene)), proteins = n(), .by = quadrant) |>
  mutate(result = map(members, function(g) {
    fgsea::fora(ora_sets, g, universe = universe, minSize = 10, maxSize = 500) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      slice_min(pval, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
      transmute(database = sub("\\|.*", "", pathway), pathway = sub("^[^|]+\\|", "", pathway),
        size, overlap, p = pval, fdr = padj)
  })) |>
  select(quadrant, proteins, result) |>
  unnest(result)
quadrant_sets |>
  slice_min(p, n = 3, by = quadrant) |>
  select(quadrant, proteins, pathway, overlap, fdr)
```

```{r page-direction}
direction_plot <- ggplot(direction_hits, aes(hlrt_logfc, bfr_logfc, colour = hit)) +
  origin_lines +
  geom_abline(slope = deming_slope, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(data = slice_max(direction_hits, abs(hlrt_logfc) + abs(bfr_logfc), n = 14),
    aes(label = gene), size = 2.2, show.legend = FALSE, max.overlaps = 30) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = arm_colours) +
  labs(x = "HLRT training log2FC", y = "BFR training log2FC", colour = "FDR < 0.05 in",
    title = "a  Training change, proteins at FDR 0.05 in either arm",
    subtitle = sprintf(paste0("%d proteins, %.0f%% same direction\nSolid: Deming slope %.2f ",
      "(descriptive, biased low by selection); dashed: slope 1"),
      nrow(direction_hits), 100 * concordance, deming_slope))
ora_plot <- quadrant_sets |>
  slice_min(p, n = 3, by = quadrant, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    pathway = substr(sub("^(HALLMARK|REACTOME)_", "", pathway), 1, 50),
    panel = paste0(quadrant, " (", proteins, " proteins)")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(-log10(fdr), reorder(pathway, -log10(fdr)))) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey45", width = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "-log10 BH q (dashed: 0.05)", y = NULL, title = "b  Top three sets per quadrant")
page_direction <- direction_plot / ora_plot + plot_layout(heights = c(1.3, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Direction: do the legs move the same proteins the same way?")
page_direction
```

## Coherence

Whether rankings, sets and modules agree between the arms. The rho and r are descriptive, because
sets overlap and modules share proteins; fry asks whether HLRT's hits move together in BFR.

```{r coherence}
signed_score <- function(ct) -log10(dep_stat(ct, "P.Value")) * sign(dep_stat(ct, "logFC"))
unique_gene <- !duplicated(dep$Genes)
arm_of <- set_names(c("bfr", "hlrt"), c(ct_bfr, ct_hlrt))
rrho <- RRHO2::RRHO2_initialize(
  data.frame(dep$Genes, signed_score(ct_hlrt))[unique_gene, ],
  data.frame(dep$Genes, signed_score(ct_bfr))[unique_gene, ],
  labels = c("HLRT training", "BFR training"), log10.ind = TRUE
)
nes <- set_tests |>
  filter(method == "fgsea", contrast %in% c(ct_bfr, ct_hlrt), database %in% set_databases) |>
  transmute(arm = arm_of[contrast], set_id, nes = NES, fdr = padj) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = c(nes, fdr)) |>
  drop_na(nes_bfr, nes_hlrt) |>
  mutate(sig = bh_in(fdr_bfr, fdr_hlrt))
nes_rho <- cor(nes$nes_hlrt, nes$nes_bfr, method = "spearman")
modules <- read_excel(module_file, "eigengene_tests") |>
  filter(contrast %in% c(ct_bfr, ct_hlrt)) |>
  transmute(arm = arm_of[contrast], module, change = estimate, fdr) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = c(change, fdr)) |>
  left_join(
    read_excel(module_file, "modules") |> filter(network == "main") |>
      select(module, proteins, hub),
    by = "module"
  )
module_r <- cor(modules$change_hlrt, modules$change_bfr)
hlrt_sets <- list(
  HLRT_up = which(dep_stat(ct_hlrt, "adj.P.Val") < 0.05 & dep_stat(ct_hlrt, "logFC") > 0),
  HLRT_down = which(dep_stat(ct_hlrt, "adj.P.Val") < 0.05 & dep_stat(ct_hlrt, "logFC") < 0)
)
fry_bfr <- fry(proteins, hlrt_sets, d$design, d$contrasts[, ct_bfr], robust = TRUE,
  sort = "none")
coherence <- bind_rows(
  tibble(statistic = "fgsea NES, BFR vs HLRT training, Spearman rho", n = nrow(nes),
    estimate = nes_rho),
  tibble(statistic = "main-network eigengene change, BFR vs HLRT training, Pearson r",
    n = nrow(modules), estimate = module_r),
  tibble(statistic = paste("fry in BFR training,", rownames(fry_bfr), "FDR set"),
    n = fry_bfr$NGenes, direction = fry_bfr$Direction, p = fry_bfr$PValue)
)
coherence
```

```{r page-coherence}
rrho_cells <- as_tibble(rrho$hypermat, .name_repair = function(x) as.character(seq_along(x))) |>
  mutate(hlrt_step = row_number()) |>
  pivot_longer(-hlrt_step, names_to = "bfr_step", values_to = "log_p",
    names_transform = as.integer)
rrho_plot <- ggplot(rrho_cells, aes(hlrt_step, bfr_step, fill = log_p)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", na.value = "white") +
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "HLRT ranking (up to down)", y = "BFR ranking (up to down)", fill = "-log10 p",
    title = "a  RRHO2 of the two training rankings",
    subtitle = sprintf("Overlap: %d up in both, %d down in both",
      length(rrho$genelist_uu$gene_list_overlap_uu),
      length(rrho$genelist_dd$gene_list_overlap_dd))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
nes_plot <- ggplot(nes, aes(nes_hlrt, nes_bfr, colour = sig)) +
  origin_lines +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(arm_colours, neither = "grey85")) +
  labs(x = "HLRT NES", y = "BFR NES", colour = "BH in",
    title = "b  Set response (Hallmark, GO Slim, Reactome)",
    subtitle = sprintf("Spearman rho %.2f over %d sets", nes_rho, nrow(nes))) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
module_plot <- ggplot(modules, aes(change_hlrt, change_bfr)) +
  origin_lines +
  geom_point(aes(size = proteins), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = paste(module, hub)), size = 2.1, max.overlaps = 30) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 5) +
  labs(x = "HLRT eigengene change", y = "BFR eigengene change", size = "Proteins",
    title = "c  Main-network module change",
    subtitle = sprintf("Pearson r %.2f over %d modules; labels: module and hub", module_r,
      nrow(modules))) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
bfr_rank <- rank(-fit$t[, ct_bfr])
barcode <- imap(hlrt_sets, function(rows, set) tibble(set = set, bfr_rank = bfr_rank[rows])) |>
  list_rbind()
barcode_plot <- ggplot(barcode, aes(bfr_rank, fill = set)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 100, boundary = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(HLRT_up = "#B2182B", HLRT_down = "#2166AC")) +
  labs(x = "Rank in BFR training (most up on the left)", y = "Proteins", fill = NULL,
    title = "d  HLRT training hits in the BFR ranking",
    subtitle = sprintf("fry in BFR: HLRT up %s (p %.1e), HLRT down %s (p %.1e)",
      fry_bfr["HLRT_up", "Direction"], fry_bfr["HLRT_up", "PValue"],
      fry_bfr["HLRT_down", "Direction"], fry_bfr["HLRT_down", "PValue"])) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
page_coherence <- (rrho_plot | nes_plot) / (module_plot | barcode_plot) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Coherence: do rankings, sets and modules agree?")
page_coherence
```

## Classification

The sPLS-DA AUCs of `07_Multivariate/02_splsda` set the between-arm comparisons against training on
one page. Panel sizes were tuned on the same data, so they lean optimistic.

```{r classification}
comparison_names <- c(
  training_bfr = "BFR: T1 vs T2", training_hlrt = "HLRT: T1 vs T2",
  arms_pre = "BFR vs HLRT, before", arms_post = "BFR vs HLRT, after",
  arms_change = "BFR vs HLRT, change"
)
classification <- read_excel(splsda_file, "models") |>
  filter(component == 1) |>
  transmute(comparison, label = comparison_names[comparison], participants = n_participants,
    panel_size = keep_x, ber = ber_max, auc, auc_sd)
classification
```

## BFR against HLRT leads

No interaction passes BH, so proteins at nominal p < 0.05 are leads. fgsea treats correlated
proteins as independent and fry passes no interaction set, so the fgsea sets are leads too.

```{r leads}
change_panel <- read_excel(splsda_file, "panels") |>
  filter(comparison == "arms_change", component == 1)
volcano_data <- tibble(
  protein = dep$protein, gene = dep$Genes,
  interaction_logfc = dep_stat(ct_inter, "logFC"), interaction_p = dep_stat(ct_inter, "P.Value"),
  interaction_fdr = dep_stat(ct_inter, "adj.P.Val"),
  bfr_logfc = dep_stat(ct_bfr, "logFC"), bfr_p = dep_stat(ct_bfr, "P.Value"),
  hlrt_logfc = dep_stat(ct_hlrt, "logFC"), hlrt_p = dep_stat(ct_hlrt, "P.Value")
) |>
  mutate(in_change_panel = protein %in% change_panel$protein, lead = interaction_p < 0.05)
leads <- volcano_data |>
  filter(lead) |>
  select(-lead) |>
  arrange(interaction_p)
inter_sets <- set_tests |>
  filter(method == "fgsea", contrast == ct_inter, database %in% set_databases) |>
  slice_min(p, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(label = sprintf("%s (q %.2g)", substr(sub("^(HALLMARK|REACTOME)_", "", pathway), 1, 45),
    padj))
c(leads = nrow(leads), larger_bfr = sum(leads$interaction_logfc > 0),
  larger_hlrt = sum(leads$interaction_logfc < 0),
  panel_in_leads = sum(leads$in_change_panel), panel = nrow(change_panel))
select(inter_sets, database, label, NES, p, padj)
```

## Response against growth

Whether a leg that moved further also grew more. Centring a participant's two legs makes them
mirror images, so the pooled within-participant p comes from 5,000 swaps of the response between a
participant's legs, not from `cor.test()`.

```{r growth-legs}
per_sample <- function(sheet_file, sheet, value) {
  read_excel(sheet_file, sheet) |>
    select(participant, leg, timepoint, value = all_of(value)) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value) |>
    transmute(participant, leg, change = T2 - T1)
}
mpe_change <- per_sample(
  here("05_Mitochondria", "02_test_mito", "c_data", "02_test_mito.xlsx"), "mpe", "mpe"
)
slow_change <- per_sample(
  here("06_Composition", "02_fibre_type", "c_data", "02_fibre_type.xlsx"), "slow_fraction",
  "slow"
)
legs <- leg_samples |>
  select(participant, leg, treatment) |>
  mutate(directional_change = directional(leg_change)) |>
  left_join(rename(mpe_change, mpe_change = change), by = c("participant", "leg")) |>
  left_join(rename(slow_change, slow_change = change), by = c("participant", "leg")) |>
  left_join(
    transmute(phenotype, participant, leg,
      vl_csa = vl_csa_post_cm2 - vl_csa_pre_cm2, rf_csa = rf_csa_post_cm2 - rf_csa_pre_cm2,
      vl_echo = vl_echo_post_au - vl_echo_pre_au, rf_echo = rf_echo_post_au - rf_echo_pre_au),
    by = c("participant", "leg"), relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>
  mutate(both_legs = participant %in% complete_legs$participant) |>
  arrange(participant, treatment)
stopifnot(!anyNA(select(legs, -both_legs)))
count(legs, treatment)
```

```{r growth-tests}
responses <- c(directional_change = "Directional change", mpe_change = "MPE change",
  slow_change = "Slow-fraction change")
outcomes <- c(vl_csa = "VL CSA change (cm²)", rf_csa = "RF CSA change (cm²)",
  vl_echo = "VL echo change (a.u.)", rf_echo = "RF echo change (a.u.)")
within_rho <- function(x, y, person, flips = 5000) {
  x <- x - ave(x, person)
  y <- y - ave(y, person)
  observed <- cor(x, y, method = "spearman")
  people <- unique(person)
  null <- replicate(flips, {
    sign_flip <- sample(c(-1, 1), length(people), replace = TRUE)[match(person, people)]
    cor(x * sign_flip, y, method = "spearman")
  })
  tibble(rho = observed, n = length(x),
    p = (1 + sum(abs(null) >= abs(observed))) / (1 + flips))
}
growth <- expand_grid(response = names(responses), outcome = names(outcomes)) |>
  mutate(result = map2(response, outcome, function(r, o) {
    by_arm <- map(c("BFR", "HLRT"), function(arm) {
      arm_legs <- filter(legs, treatment == arm)
      test <- cor.test(arm_legs[[r]], arm_legs[[o]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
      tibble(analysis = arm, rho = unname(test$estimate), n = nrow(arm_legs), p = test$p.value)
    })
    paired <- filter(legs, both_legs)
    bind_rows(by_arm, mutate(within_rho(paired[[r]], paired[[o]], paired$participant),
      analysis = "within participant"))
  })) |>
  unnest(result) |>
  select(response, outcome, analysis, rho, n, p)
growth |>
  slice_max(abs(rho), n = 6) |>
  mutate(across(c(rho, p), function(x) signif(x, 2)))
```

```{r page-growth}
growth_points <- legs |>
  pivot_longer(names(responses), names_to = "response", values_to = "response_value") |>
  pivot_longer(names(outcomes), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "outcome_value") |>
  mutate(response = factor(responses[response], responses),
    outcome = factor(outcomes[outcome], outcomes))
growth_labels <- growth |>
  mutate(text = sprintf("%s %.2f (p %.2g)", sub(" participant", "", analysis), rho, p)) |>
  summarise(text = paste(text, collapse = "\n"), .by = c(response, outcome)) |>
  mutate(response = factor(responses[response], responses),
    outcome = factor(outcomes[outcome], outcomes))
growth_plot <- ggplot(growth_points, aes(outcome_value, response_value, colour = treatment)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = growth_labels, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = text), inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.04, vjust = 1.1, size = 1.9, lineheight = 0.9) +
  facet_grid(response ~ outcome, scales = "free", switch = "both") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0.05, 0.45))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = arm_colours[c("BFR", "HLRT")]) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = NULL,
    subtitle = "Spearman rho per arm, and within participant after centring each person's legs") +
  theme(legend.position = "top", strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
page_growth <- growth_plot / plot_spacer() + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.3)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Response against growth, per leg")
page_growth
```

```{r write}
tests <- bind_rows(
```
